# ellmos-unified-gui

> Importable operator console for the ellmos/BACH ecosystem: one capability-driven
> web UI (FastAPI + HTMX, no build step) over existing backends — models, agents,
> prompts, routing, permissions, routines/cron, tasks, tickets, skills.
> Status: Phase 1-4 mostly implemented (v0.8.0, verified 2026-08-21),
> 12 panels (P1-P12), 175/175 tests passing (measured 2026-08-21). Real-mounted
> into ellmos-core since 2026-08-18 (console_enabled there). P11 skill wizard
> (structured scaffold+description+static tests via catalog.py, not the skill
> body/eval loop -- that stays skill-creator's job). Audit log for every
> write action across all panels (~/.ellmos/unified-gui/audit.jsonl, modeled
> on ellmos-controlcenter-mcp's gateway-audit.jsonl). Phase 4 remainder
> (BACH mount, homebase adapter) open. P12 provides a read-only compare-race
> report browser. German technical planning docs are canonical.

## Docs

- [KONZEPT.md](KONZEPT.md): problem, goals, panel catalog P1-P12, migration path

- [TODO.md](TODO.md): phased roadmap
- [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md): trust boundaries and vulnerability reporting

## Key facts

- Two run modes: create_app() standalone, mount(app, prefix) embedded (BACH, ellmos-core)
- Panels appear only if their backend capabilities are probed successfully
- No own domain store: canonical schemas are profiprompt-library-v1.json,
  LOCK.permissions.json, BACH scheduler_jobs, ticket-master T-*.txt files
